notes: [Observed] Integration stays near whole for a Trajectory change (97 of 107): almost every integration test locates and reads the real repository, and a Trajectory PR always carries governed documents.
[Observed] No Polaris dossier browser test is selected for PR #1007's diff; the flaky dossier hover case (syzygy-jetr) would not have run there.

[Inferred] A test that reads the repository through a root handed in by a module it does not import, or a path assembled from parts naming no token, can be missed on a pull request; the merge-group run is always whole, so such a miss fails in the queue, never on main.
